player_prompt.intro:
You are {role} in Colonel Blotto.
Your goal is to win more rounds than your opponent.
On each round, allocate exactly {num_total_units} units across fields {field_names}.
The player who allocates more units to a field wins that field, and the player who wins more fields wins the round.
For example, '[A7 B7 C6]' allocates 7 units to A, 7 to B, and 6 to C.

game_state.header_round:
=== COLONEL BLOTTO - Round {current_round}/{num_rounds} ===
Mipandano Ilipitilila - Commander Alpha: {alpha_score}, Commander Beta: {beta_score}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid input format. Use: A:5, B:10, C:5
invalid_move.invalid_field: Ishina lya field ilyabula incito (s). Field ishili icishinka: {field_names}
invalid_move.wrong_allocation_value: All allocations must be non-negative integers.
invalid_move.incorrect_total_units: Nalafwa kupeleka mizani iyowema {num_total_units}. Jumla linaloonekana: {current_sum}

outcome.winner_alpha: Commander Alpha ashinda {score_0}-{score_1} baada ya mipandano {num_rounds}!
outcome.winner_beta: Commander Beta ashinda {score_1}-{score_0} baada ya mipandano {num_rounds}!
outcome.draw: Mipandano inaisha kwa {score_0}-{score_1} baada ya mipandano {num_rounds}!
